Name: Ahlab
Description: A town in Asher's allotment which Asher did not drive out, named among Accho, Zidon, Achzib, Helbah, Aphik and Rehob. The same site has also been proposed for Helbah, so this identification is not certain.
BiblicalSignificance: Ahlab is one of the unfinished conquests: Israel dwelt among the Canaanites there instead of driving them out, and the compromise lingered.
